rationale: The child is a congratulatory endorsement of a private foundation's highway-safety broadcasting awards, explaining the media's role in sustaining an existing public program and urging broad industry participation. C21 is the closest in occasion and genre because it praises an award and its recipient; C10 similarly commends an organization's public service and favors its proposed action; C04 links an individual to a public-interest program. But none shares distinctive language, the child's argument about public information sustaining highway-safety gains, or a parallel operative structure concrete enough to indicate reuse. The similarities are generic conventions of presidential letters endorsing civic initiatives.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am delighted to learn of the new radio awards initiated by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is a personal satisfaction to me that the Honorable George C. Marshall, Secretary of State, will receive on this happy occasion the tribute of your annual award.
shared_material.explanation: C21 also offers presidential praise in connection with an award, but the wording and substantive purpose differ and reflect only a generic congratulatory-letter function.

shared_material.child_excerpt: thereby testifying to a truly comprehensive effort on the part of the industry in this important field of public service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I think your organization has rendered a distinct public service in taking a stand on this matter.
shared_material.explanation: C10 shares the generic idea that a private organization's action constitutes public service, without distinctive phrasing or parallel administrative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The active support of radio and the other public information media has been a vital factor in the success of the Action Program
shared_material.parent_excerpt: can again play an important role in the development of a vital program
shared_material.explanation: C04 contains broadly similar language about an important role in a vital program, but it concerns an appointment to a presidential committee and does not reproduce the child's substantive reasoning or sequence.
